title: .NET 11 runtime adds runtime async and decimal compatibility changes
summary: Microsoft&\#x27;s .NET 11 runtime documentation covers new runtime async support and compatibility changes for .NET developers. One flagged compatibility change affects decimal conversion: the double literal 0.1 becomes 0.1 on .NET 10 but 0.1000000000000000055511151231 on .NET 11. The supplied material does not provide independent performance measurements or a complete list of runtime features.
